templateForm.createDescription: Create a fully customizable rate template with components. Combine base salaries, time-based rates, bonuses, and multipliers as needed.

components.title: Rate Components
components.emptyDescription: Add components to define how staff will be paid. You can combine base salaries, time-based rates, special bonuses, and multipliers.

templateForm.componentsTooltip: Components define how payment is calculated. You can combine: base salary (monthly/biweekly), time-based rates (minute/hour), bonuses (night/weekend), and multipliers (overtime/holidays).

componentForm.typeTooltip: Select what type of payment this component represents. For example: Base Salary (fixed monthly pay), Per Minute (paid by time worked), Night Bonus (extra for night shifts), etc.
componentForm.unitTooltip: Define how often or per what event this component is paid. For example: Monthly (once a month), Per Shift (each time they work), Per Minute (based on minutes worked).
componentForm.valueTooltip: Enter the numeric value. For salaries and bonuses use your country's currency. For multipliers use decimals (e.g. 1.5 = 150%). For percentages use numbers (e.g. 10 = 10%).
componentForm.applyConditionTooltip: Define in which situations this component will be applied. 'Always' includes it in all shifts. Other options limit it to night hours, weekends, holidays, etc.
componentForm.descriptionPlaceholder: Add notes or clarifications about this component
